thirty_sec: Two brothers ran a small, efficient hamburger business in Southern California and made a comfortable living. Ray Kroc partnered with them, and between 1955 and 1959 about a hundred restaurants opened. Four years later there were five hundred. John Maxwell uses it to show a lid: leadership ability sets how far everything else can go, and you can raise it by learning to lead.
